title: CNC Memory — Program Storage Near Full
description: CNC program memory P081 = {val}%. Less than {val2} MB available. Large programs may not load.
diagnostic_steps: Review program list for obsolete programs
remedy: Delete or archive old NC programs. Maintain minimum 20% free memory.
required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.
escalation_path: If CNC-MD-011 is not addressed (log fault. schedule maintenance within 24 hours. reduce feed rate by 20%.), the fault will escalate in this order: CNC-SR-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
